data.summary: Decided to finish and release ProjectMapper publicly after using it in real projects.
data.evidence: Internal use showed it reliably reduces AI context setup time. Revival decision recorded in dev journal.

data.summary: v1.0.0 released on GitHub. Snapshot compiler, tree view, filedump export, backups.
data.evidence: Tag v1.0.0 pushed. 335 tests pass on Python 3.10, 3.13, 3.14 on Windows, macOS, Linux.

data.summary: v1.1.0: CLI adapter and MCP server added. Agents can now drive ProjectMapper over JSON-RPC.
data.evidence: Phase 9 steps 9.1–9.5 implemented. Adapter passes 389 tests. MCP SDK conditional import.

data.summary: Project transforms (Phase 10): multi-file patch operations with approval UI, operation review, undo via backup generations. Star-import fixes, per-operation approval controls.
data.evidence: Phase 10.6a accepted. 446 tests pass. Cross-platform CI matrix passes 9 jobs.

data.summary: SchemaTOUCHER V1: dual-view GUI tool for creating and browsing JSONL spine files. Schema registration, entry form, browse panel with per-entry schema rendering. Single-file .jsonl spine format — schema and entry records in one append-only stream.
data.evidence: 501 tests pass. CLI (spine-cli) added. Design session recorded in .spine/schematoucher-design.jsonl.

data.summary: Sidecar distribution model: public repo cloned directly as <project>/.project-mapper/. App derives project root from its own install location. No ZIP extraction required. Generated data (snapshots, spines) stays out of git via .gitignore.
data.evidence: SIDECAR_ROOT_NAME changed to .project-mapper. Detection updated for no app/ subdir. run.sh and setup_env.sh added for Unix. setup_env.bat uses %~dp0 paths.

data.summary: Public repository .project-mapper created and cold-clone verified. See INSTALL.md for results.
data.evidence: All 10 verification checks passed on Windows. macOS/Linux pending (CI matrix covers these platforms).

data.summary: Established update convention: all app-level changes (releases, decisions, fixes) are recorded in project-lineage.jsonl in the public repo. This keeps the scaffold (the app and its own history) cleanly separated from any project the user installs it into. project-lineage.jsonl is the app's journal; spines in the user's project are the project's journal.
data.evidence: Backlog item C5 added for duplicate timestamps. Convention adopted going forward.

data.summary: Evidence field convention: reference immutable pointers (git SHAs) where possible. When referencing mutable prose, paste the key sentence verbatim into evidence rather than describing it. No hash field needed — the JSONL record is the source of truth.
data.evidence: Decision: leave lineage-event@1 schema unchanged. Verbatim text in evidence is preferred over a separate content_hash field, which would require the original text anyway.

data.summary: Open concern: spine file growth. Each entry stores full text inline; verbatim evidence compounds this. Deduplication (shared text blocks, reference-by-hash) may be needed once spines grow unwieldy.
data.evidence: Parked as backlog item. No action yet — dedup adds read complexity and the current size is manageable.
